purpose: Teach: くっつけ/談笑/オット/奥底/仇/ぶさ/里帰り/見いだす

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメモを冷蔵庫にくっつけてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad left a note on the fridge.
lines.style: Gentle observation, warm tone. Softly delivering something tender. Slight pause before speaking, like she's noticing his attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと談笑してたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was talking and laughing with Dad earlier.
lines.style: Bright, quick delivery. A small voice that's eager to share. Guileless enthusiasm, like he's proud of this moment and wants her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんのオットがお父さんよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is your mom's husband.
lines.style: Quiet, patient redirection. Not correcting harshly — more like sitting beside him. Soft but clear. A tender truth he's still learning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、心の奥底でメイ姉さんに感謝してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really thankful for you in my heart.
lines.style: Small, genuine tone. Words coming slow, careful. Like he's felt this for a while and it's finally coming out. Quiet at the end, vulnerable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、誰も仇のように見てはダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you mustn't think of anyone as an enemy.
lines.style: Warm but firm conviction. Speaking as someone who cares deeply. Measured pace, each word carrying weight without sounding heavy. A small lesson wrapped in affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、犬がぶさかわで可愛いって思ってる
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think the dog is so funny-looking but really cute.
lines.style: Small voice, brightening mid-thought. The delight of noticing something small and wanting to share it. Genuine warmth on cute. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが里帰りに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is taking you back to his hometown.
lines.style: Warm, almost asides-like. Speaking plainly, like she's pleased to share something good with him. Soft tone, inviting him to feel the brightness of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが「夢を見いだす」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad said we should 'find our dreams.'
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. Repeating something he's been turning over. Serious-careful, like these are big words for a small boy and he's holding them seriously. Closes with quiet reverence.
